name: Welcome
subject: Welcome to Breathermae
body:
Welcome to Breathermae!

Our mission is simple: help you better understand the interconnected patterns influencing your health, well-being, and performance so you can make more informed decisions with confidence.

Whether you’re seeking greater balance, improved resilience, enhanced performance, or simply a deeper understanding of yourself, Breathermae provides tools, education, assessments, and personalized insights designed to support your journey.

Start by filling out the Authorization Form which includes our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Once completed, explore what our site has to offer including the many self-assessments, laboratory testing products, educational tools, and more!

Breathermae

Thank you!

The Breathermae Team

name: Wellness Profile
subject: Complete your Wellness Profile
body:
Hello [first name]! 

A good way to get started with Breathermae is to complete a very short Wellness Profile.

By answering a short series of questions, you’ll help us uncover what matters most to you—whether that’s performance, energy, stress, lifestyle habits, or overall health awareness.

Your responses allow us to tailor the experience specifically to your situation, rather than offering one‑size‑fits‑all recommendations. This quick set of questions is free and will help guide you to the next level with immediate feedback.

Wellness Profile

Thank you for considering Breathermae!

name: Health Profile
subject: Complete your Health Profile
body:
Hi there [first_name],

Before you continue exploring Breathermae, we’d love to learn a little more about you.

Your Health Profile helps us tailor your experience with more accurate insights, personalized recommendations, and assessments that reflect your unique wellness picture. It only takes a moment to complete, and includes basic information such as your name, sex, gender, height, weight, and birthday.  There is other information that is optional that helps us understand your current needs as well, but only if you wish to share with us.

Once it’s filled out, the platform can adapt to your needs and provide a more meaningful, relevant experience. You can update your Health Profile anytime — but completing it now ensures you get the most out of everything Breathermae offers. 

If you have any questions or need help along the way, we’re here for you. Simply reply to this email with any questions that you may have and someone will get back with you shortly.

Breathermae

Warmly,

The Breathermae Team
